lessons.note: Unknown agent-name suggestion lives at the single error source (loadAgent in company.go:238) so both run and loop benefit with no per-command duplication; loadAgentNames already enumerates candidates. Used distinct symbol names (agentNameDistance/nearestAgentName/unknownAgentError) to avoid duplicate-symbol collision with the still-unmerged suggest.go (#32 levenshtein/suggestCommand) and subaction_suggest.go (#40 actionDistance/nearestAction). Existing TestLoadAgentMissingFile requires the error to keep the agent name AND agents dir — preserve both when enriching.
